caption: The footer row has only two td tags: Sum carries colspan=2 and so covers columns 1 and 2, while 70 sits in column 3. Check the body amounts: 20 + 50 = 70.

spec.title: Stationery bill grid
spec.aria: A grid of four rows and three columns: the header row is Item, Qty, Rs; the body rows are Pen 2 20 and Ink 1 50; in the footer row the first cell Sum is marked colspan=2 so it covers columns 1 and 2 of the three-column grid, and 70 is the cell in column 3.
